Class Enemy

java.lang.Object
game.entities.enemies.Enemy
Direct Known Subclasses:
BasicEnemy, CamoEnemy, CamoRegenEnemy, FastEnemy, FastFlyingCamoRegenEnemy, FlyingEnemy, RegenEnemy, TankEnemy
public abstract class Enemy extends Object
The base class for all enemies (bloons) in the game. It handles movement, health, rendering, and path tracking.

    • move

      public void move()
      Moves the enemy toward its next waypoint. If it reaches a waypoint, it targets the next one.

    • syncImagePosition

      protected void syncImagePosition()
      Updates the JavaFX ImageView so it perfectly centers on the logical X and Y coordinates.

    • getPathProgress

      public double getPathProgress()
      Calculates how far the enemy is along the entire track. Used by towers to target the enemy closest to the exit.
      Returns:
      A number representing path progress (higher means closer to the end).

    • updateColor

      private void updateColor()
      Updates the enemy's image based on its current health layer.
